description: Defines the User entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties, ORM mappings, and methods related to user data management.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Entity class representing a user in the OrangeHRM system, with properties for user details, relationships to employee and role entities, and ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the user's unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the user's unique identifier.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username.

methods.name: getUserPassword
methods.description: Returns the user's password.

methods.name: setUserPassword
methods.description: Sets the user's password.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the user is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the user as deleted or not.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the user's status.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the user's status.

methods.name: getDateEntered
methods.description: Returns the date the user was entered.

methods.name: setDateEntered
methods.description: Sets the date the user was entered.

methods.name: getDateModified
methods.description: Returns the date the user was last modified.

methods.name: setDateModified
methods.description: Sets the date the user was last modified.

methods.name: getModifiedUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who last modified this user.

methods.name: setModifiedUserId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who last modified this user.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the creator of this user.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the ID of the creator of this user.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the associated Employee entity.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with this user.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this user.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the role assigned to the user.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Assigns a role to the user.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns the collection of authentication providers linked to the user.

methods.name: setAuthProviders
methods.description: Sets the collection of authentication providers for the user.
